limitations: One durable session key and four lease identities. Checks exact acknowledgement, serialized claims, duplicate enqueue and loss of a claim response. Fair retirement requires an eventual successful drain for the stale entry.

Real Workerd checks cover parallel pollers, expiry recovery, stale-entry cleanup and receipt replacement. Provider delivery and Redis compatibility are separate. The model permits explicit re-enqueue after deletion and does not prove exactly-once delivery.
Onboarding continuation identity, transcript migration, replay alarm pagination, batch partial failures and unbounded queue order remain separate coverage.
